Khamoshi sach bolti hai.
Jis din hum un cheezon par chup ho jaate hain jo matter karti hain, us din zindagi ka end shuru hota hai.
Toughness: pata ho tum bach jaoge.
Tabhi bolo jab aapka bolna khamoshi se behtar ho.
Khamoshi sona hai.
Aakhir mein humein dushman ke bol nahi, balki doston ki khamoshi yaad rahegi.
Success final nahi, failure fatal nahi—continue ka courage matter karta hai.
Dhairya kadwa hota hai, lekin iska phal meetha hota hai.
Grit sona hai.
Khamoshi dheemi hai.
Chuppi ek gehri taqat hai.
Sabr aur himmat hi asli taj hai.
Sabar kamyabi ka pul hai.
Grit effort ko destiny banata hai.
Jab sab haar maan lein, tabhi asli grit dikhta hai.
Duniya me kuch bhi worth nahi—jab tak woh effort, pain, difficulty na maange.
Bahadur bano, himmat rakho.
Khamoshi kala hai.
Grit hope + effort hai.
